templates.label: Templates
templates.description: The templates offered by the picker dropdown, in display order. Run Scan to pull in every #template note you have; each row's Enabled flag controls whether it appears, and the row move controls set the dropdown order.

name.label: Name
name.description: The label shown in the picker dropdown. Defaults to the template note's title when discovered by Scan; editing it here only changes the dropdown text, not the note.

templateNoteId.label: Template Note
templateNoteId.description: The #template note this row assigns. Filled in by Scan; a row whose note no longer exists is skipped by the picker.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this template appears in the picker dropdown.

color.label: Color
color.description: Optional: mirrored onto a note's #color label when this template is assigned. Leave blank for no color.

actionable.label: Actionable
actionable.description: Whether notes using this template represent actionable work (for other addons that flow actionable notes through priority/scheduling queues).

icon.label: Bucket Icon
icon.description: BoxIcons class, without the leading "bx" (e.g. "bx-check"). Used by other addons that scaffold one folder per template. Leave blank for a generic folder icon.

excludeFilters.label: Exclude Filters
excludeFilters.description: Notes matching any enabled filter's search query are hidden from the Template picker widget and skipped by the Missing Templates triage list.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Trilium search syntax (same as the search bar), e.g. #template or note.type = code.
